svg.text: #611 Enterprise Supply Chain & Logistics AI: LLM Constraint Parser + cuOpt 1.8s VRP Solver
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · 5,000 Trucks (150,000 Stops/Day) · 0.0% Time-Window Violations · -14.8% Fleet Fuel & Empty Miles ($11.2M/yr)
1. Solving Dynamic Vehicle Routing (CVRPTW · 15,000 Stops)
✕ Why Autoregressive LLMs Cannot Solve Vehicle Routing Directly
• Asking 70B LLM to output routes for 500 trucks × 30 stops violates truck weight,
cold-chain temperature, and dock time windows on 31.5% of routes!
✓ Neuro-Symbolic Stack: LLM Constraint Compiler + NVIDIA cuOpt
• Stage 1 (2× H100 · Qwen2.5-32B + XGrammar): Translates unstructured driver
messages, port delays & VIP customer emails into JSON constraint matrices (0.4s)
• Stage 2 (2× H100 · NVIDIA cuOpt GPU ALNS/MILP Solver): Re-optimizes 15,000
stops in 1.8 seconds (vs. 45 minutes on legacy CPU MIP solvers — 1,500x faster!)
• Result: 0.0% Time-Window Violations · -14.8% Fleet Fuel & Empty Miles ($11.2M/yr)
2. Warehouse Dock VLM & Customs Bill-of-Lading IDP
Automated Receiving Dock Pallet & Waybill Inspection (80 Warehouses)
• Forklift/dock gate cameras capture pallet shrink-wrap damage & multi-barcode labels
• 4× L40S runs MinerU + Qwen2.5-VL on 20,000 daily packing lists & damaged cartons
• Cuts dock receiving check-in time from 14 minutes to 22 seconds per truck!
Global 3PL Logistics AI Fleet TCO & Net Savings
• Complete Fleet: 4× L40S (Waybill IDP + Dock VLM) + 4× H100 (LLM Parser + cuOpt)
= 8 GPUs ($13,000/month infrastructure cost)
• Annual Fleet Fuel & Overtime Savings (5,000 Trucks): $11,200,000 / year
• Infrastructure payback period: Less than 11 hours of fleet operation!
3. Supply-Chain AI Golden Rule: LLM as "Natural-Language-to-Matrix Compiler"
• Use the LLM strictly to translate messy human exceptions ("Customer B dock closed 2–4pm due to rain") into cuOpt JSON constraints.
• Delegate 100% of combinatorial route & bin-packing optimization to GPU parallel heuristics (cuOpt).
